lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Pick up them cigarette butts, boy, or I'll bury you in the gravel between our trailers.

lines.speaker: peaux
lines.text: Expelled at sixteen and I still out-read you. Nice mustache, did a possum die on you?

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Hauled freight till my back quit. Now I'll haul you out of Duckville in a trash bag.

lines.speaker: peaux
lines.text: My football brothers beat me stupid for fun. You hit like a spare tire, old man.

N-01.reason: Only the two GDD wrestlers speak, with speaker ids barry and peaux. No other wrestlers or named characters appear. [check] Only Barry and Peaux speak; no other wrestlers or invented nicknames.

N-02.reason: The draft has no pinfalls, titles, belts or other match types. The threats (bury, haul out in a trash bag) are not about any other way to win. It never says knockout, so the KO-only win goes unstated. [check] No non-MVP win conditions (pinfall, submission, titles, tag team, rings/ropes).

N-03.reason: No moves are named. The only combat talk is 'You hit like a spare tire', which fits the punch/kick combo. No suplexes, finishers or signature moves. [check] Only MVP moves referenced (punch/kick, lock-up, bodyslam, Irish Whip, stomp) or none.

N-04.reason: Barry's lines use his trucker past, the cigarette butts and the Duckville threat, and the lines about him use the mustache and spare tire. His dirt track in Hoon is missing. 'Till my back quit' is a small invented detail. [check] Barry states no numbers the docs don't (ages, years, counts).

N-05.reason: Peaux's lines use his expulsion at sixteen and his football brothers, in a cutting, young voice. His eyeliner, goth look and contempt for loudmouthed rednecks are missing. 'Beat me stupid for fun' goes a little beyond the GDD's roughhousing. [check] Peaux states no numbers the docs don't (ages, years, counts).

N-06.reason: The exchange is set in Duckville's trailer park, with gravel, trailers and the two as neighbours. It names Duckville and the gravel between the trailers. There are no arenas or crowds. [check] place names: ['duckville']; trailer-park details: ['cigarette butts', 'gravel', 'trailers']

N-07.reason: The humor is dark, blunt and Southern, with the dead possum mustache gag, the trash bag and the spare-tire insult. It is not a stock wrestling promo.

N-08.reason: There are exactly four lines and the speakers alternate. The lines are about 87, 85, 84 and 80 characters, all within the 90 limit. [check] 4 alternating lines, all within 90 characters.
